headline: Junior AI & ML Engineer
summary: AI Engineering graduate with distinction who combines applied AI with dependable software delivery. Hands-on experience spans computer vision, OCR, GenAI, RAG, agentic systems, model evaluation, Python APIs, data pipelines, MLOps, and cloud deployment. Enjoys turning open-ended problems into practical solutions, communicating technical choices clearly, and building AI that is reliable and useful in real environments.
internship_bullets: Built an end-to-end Python pipeline that transforms echocardiographic DICOM studies into structured research data using computer vision, OCR, and review tooling.
Designed resumable batch processing, validation queues, traceable outputs, structured logging, and cross-platform documentation for a workflow used with real clinical imaging data.
Reduced one representative OpenCV and metadata-based source-video matching run from roughly 21 hours to 23 minutes.
apolloon_bullets: Engineered a paid client platform with React, TypeScript, Express, Electron, SQLite, tRPC, and Socket.IO for the operation of 24-hour running events.
Translated operational needs into clear workflows, realtime synchronisation, automatic LAN discovery, replicated failover, health checks, and reliable offline operation.
